answer: Six lenders in our records are not in the e-payoff network: Coastal Credit Union, Harbor Trust Bank, Oakline Finance, Redstone Credit, Summit Peak Bank and Valley Motor Credit. Customers with loans from these lenders need to bring a payoff letter to the appointment. If they'd rather not get it themselves, they can sign form NW-LPA-1 and we'll request the letter for them; allow 2 business days. The network lenders are Bayline Credit Union, Northwind Auto Finance, Meridian Auto Loans, Pinewood Federal Credit Union, Lakeshore Bank and Granite Bank (which joined on March 15, 2026). We confirm their payoffs electronically on the same day, so their customers don't need a letter.
